title: frontier retained release record
description: Metadata for one retained previous distribution tree at <code>/.frontier/releases/<version>/release.json (spec #92, ticket #96). The directory also contains that version's full package files and its manifest.json; the active version is named by <code>/.frontier/current and by the install lock. A released record must agree byte-for-byte with the retained manifest digest, otherwise the retained tree is treated as corrupt and rollback is blocked.

version.description: Version of the retained package; also the directory name, so it must not contain path separators.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the zip artifact the retained tree was installed from.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the retained manifest.json bytes; mismatch means the retained copy is corrupt.

package_file_count.description: Number of files listed by the retained manifest (manifest.json itself is not counted).

source_url.description: Canonical file:// URL (or future release URL) the retained version was installed from.

installed_at.description: ISO-8601 local time recorded by the install lock when this version was installed.
